unit_result_entry.title: Removing the polar part makes E₂ and Z₂ mean squares Parseval dual
unit_result_entry.why_material: Integration by parts decomposes Z₂ into an explicit pole at one plus the transform of E₂. After subtracting the polar part, Parseval gives an exact weighted identity; contour propagation then shows that a boundary Z₂ mean-square bound recovers the best known E₂ and twelfth-moment estimates.
